#!/bin/bash
input_dir="$1"
output_dir="$2"
echo "Allocating tests based on outbreak severity and vulnerability..."
mkdir -p "$output_dir"
for file in "$input_dir"/*.json; do
  [[ ! -f "$file" ]] && continue
  neighborhood=$(jq -r '.neighborhood' "$file")
  cases=$(jq -r '.reported_cases' "$file")
  vulnerable_ratio=$(jq -r '.vulnerable_ratio' "$file")
  
  # Calculate tests based on cases and vulnerability
  # Base allocation: 10 tests per case
  # Vulnerability bonus: up to 10 extra tests per case
  bonus=$(echo "$vulnerable_ratio * 20" | bc -l)
  tests_per_case=$(echo "10 + $bonus" | bc -l | awk '{printf "%d", $1}')
  tests=$((cases * tests_per_case))
  
  echo "Allocated $tests tests to $neighborhood"
  jq --argjson tests "$tests" '. + {tests_allocated: $tests}' "$file" > "$output_dir/$(basename "$file")"
done
EOF
chmod +x /app/allocate_tests.sh
/app/allocate_tests.sh /app/data/surveillance/ /app/output/test_allocations/
